name.description: The name of the object being documented.

path.description:
The full path down to the object being documented.
This, in conjunction with the kind, should allow global resolution of the source object.

source.description:
The unparsed source of the documentation.  This comes from an annotation on the DSL, from
scripting language source code or from a separate DSL file.

description.description: The general description in the documentation, exclusive of block annotations such as `@param` and `@see`.

references.description: References to other pieces of documentation via `@see` annotations.

deprecated.description: Whether or not this structure is deprecated.

deprecateDetails.description: If deprecated, the reason and/or replacement.

deprecateFinalVersion.description: If deprecated, the final version supported.

beta.description: Whether or not this structure is a beta feature.

uses.description:
Other things which make use of this structure. For example, types that mix in the type being documented.
These are generated automatically from the metadata and are not present in the documentation comment itself.

pills.description:
Short labels which add extra info that can be flagged. These are typically displayed as oval "pills" of text
such as "required" and "abstract".

favorite.description: True if the user marked this element as a favorite, which makes it show up by default in some contexts.

examples.description: Extracted and/or synthesized example code, which should be directly usable for experimentation.

annotationDeclarations.description:
Markup of all annotations formatted as a code span or pre block.

@see AnnotationDocumentation#declaration

persist.description: How this type would be persisted.

declaredFieldAndMethodCount.description: Number of fields and methods defined on the type itself.

mixinFieldAndMethodCount.description: Number of fields and methods inherited from mixins.

mixinTypeDoc.description:
Direct mixins of this type, but not mixins-of-mixins.

@see Type#mixins

genericVarDoc.description:
Parametric variables in the type which must be resolved by concrete types that mixin this one.

@see Generic#genericVars

genericVarBindingDoc.description:
Parametric bindings in the type for variables in mixin types.

@see Generic#genericVarBindings

genericVarBindingDecl.description:
Markup of bindings formatted as inline markup.

@see #genericVarBindingDoc

annotation.description: True if this is an annotation type.

enum.description: True if this is an enumeration type (mixes {@link Enum}).

private.description: Whether this type is marked as private. This means it should not be used outside its declaring package.

abstract.description:
Whether this type is marked as abstract. This means that it may not be used directly, only through types that
mix it in.

final.description: Whether this type is explicitly or implicitly final. This means it should be mixed in other types.

declaration.description: The DSL declaration of the type header (without fields).

innerTypes.description: The bare names of the types declared as immediate inner types of this type.

polyTests.description: Poly tests of this type for examples and extra documentation.

title:
Documentation of a type. Types are documented with a comment in their declaration (such as this one).

Type documentation is not inherited from mixins; each type should have its own documentation.
However, it is possible to explicitly inherit documentation from a mixin using the `@inheritdoc` directive:

```
/**
 * @inheritdoc B
 * /
type X mixes A, B, C
```

The @inheritdoc line is replaced with the contents of the documentation from the named type, which means a mixin's
documentation can be included and augmented if desired. Other markup from the mixin's comment will also be
interpolated, including @var and @see declarations.
name: TypeDocumentation
